description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating and retrieving information about lines within a document object, likely used in a code editor or diff viewer context.

methods.name: getLine(doc, n)
methods.description: Finds and returns the line object corresponding to the given line number in the document.

methods.name: getBetween(doc, start, end)
methods.description: Returns an array of strings representing the text between two positions in the document.

methods.name: getLines(doc, from, to)
methods.description: Returns an array of strings representing lines between specified indices in the document.

methods.name: updateLineHeight(line, height)
methods.description: Updates the height of a line and propagates the change upward through parent nodes.

methods.name: lineNo(line)
methods.description: Calculates the line number of a given line object by traversing parent links.

methods.name: lineAtHeight(chunk, h)
methods.description: Finds the line at a specific vertical height within the document's layout tree.

methods.name: isLine(doc, l)
methods.description: Checks if a line number falls within the range of the document.

methods.name: lineNumberFor(options, i)
methods.description: Formats a line number according to provided options.

ctags.name: isLine
ctags.pattern: /^export function isLine(doc, l) {return l >= doc.first && l < doc.first + doc.size}$/
